title: Prevent cognitive debt by manually retyping LLM-generated code
summary: The author proposes manually retyping LLM-generated code as a technique to prevent 'cognitive debt' - the knowledge gap that accumulates when developers use AI-generated code without fully understanding it. This practice forces active engagement with the code, improves retention, and helps developers build genuine expertise while still leveraging AI productivity gains.
problem_solved: Addresses the knowledge gap and technical debt that accumulates when developers rely on AI-generated code without fully understanding it.
why_valuable: Provides a practical balance between leveraging AI productivity and maintaining deep technical understanding, helping developers avoid becoming dependent on tools they don't comprehend.
